page_title: VER 2-0 CAG | Verona v Cagliari 23/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
90+6' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
90+4' Verona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+3' What was Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Verona.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' 2 - 0 Goal! Jordi Mboula plays in Milan Djuric (Verona), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 2:0.
88' Jordi Mboula (Verona) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Simone Scuffet.
87' What a long-range shot by Ondrej Duda (Verona). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Verona comes to nothing.

86' What a save from Simone Scuffet! Milan Djuric (Verona) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
86' A substitution has been made. Edoardo Goldaniga goes off and Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) comes on.
84' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) threads a pass through to Jordi Mboula, but Simone Scuffet breaks up the move.
83' Josh Doig (Verona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
78' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch for Pantelis Hatzidiakos.
77' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) replacing Gaetano Oristanio.
77' Substitution. Cyril Ngonge is replaced by Jordi Mboula (Verona).
75' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Darko Lazovic, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
74' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) attempts to find Milan Djuric, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
70' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
70' The ball is cleared after Cyril Ngonge (Verona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
69' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
68' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is cleared to safety by the defence.
68' Substitution. Riccardo Saponara leaves the pitch and is replaced by Darko Lazovic (Verona).
66' Milan Djuric (Verona) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
66' Josh Doig (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
65' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
64' Pantelis Hatzidiakos (Cagliari) serves up a nice cross, but Lorenzo Montipo punches the ball away.
63' Ondrej Duda (Verona) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
62' The resulting corner from Tomas Suslov (Verona) is cleared.
62' Tomas Suslov (Verona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
61' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick goes way wide to the right. Poor shot!
60' Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul. Verona win a free kick.
59' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Nicolas Viola and he is replaced by Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari).
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch so that Tommaso Augello can be given a rest.
58' Ondrej Duda (Verona) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
58' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
57' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) attempts to discuss the decision with Daniele Orsato, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
57' Tomas Suslov (Verona) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Daniele Orsato's book.
53' 1 - 0 Cyril Ngonge (Verona) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Simone Scuffet with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
52' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
51' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) sends a long ball forward to Cyril Ngonge, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
48' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
46' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Milan Djuric (Verona) replaces Thomas Henry.
46' We are about to witness a subsitution. Josh Doig (Verona) for Filippo Terracciano.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Ondrej Duda (Verona) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
42' Riccardo Saponara (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Simone Scuffet, who smothers the ball.
41' Tomas Suslov (Verona) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
40' Tomas Suslov (Verona) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. It will be a corner kick for Verona.
39' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
37' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Lorenzo Montipo easily deals with the threat.

35' What a poor attempt! Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
33' A cross by Cyril Ngonge (Verona) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
33' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Simone Scuffet is quickest to intercept the ball.
29' Thomas Henry (Verona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
29' The referee blows his whistle, Verona are awarded a corner kick.
28' Tomas Suslov (Verona) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Simone Scuffet makes a smart save to deny him.
26' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
26' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cagliari.
25' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
24' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
22' Fine play by Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the left post.
21' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Orsato blows for a foul.
20' A cross from a corner kick by Verona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
19' Tomas Suslov (Verona) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Pawel Dawidowicz, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
18' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Thomas Henry, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
17' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) sends a long ball in, but Simone Scuffet comfortably gathers the ball.
16' A pass by Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
15' Nicolas Viola picks out Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the right post.
15' The free kick into the penalty area from Tomas Suslov (Verona) is cleared.
12' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
12' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
12' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
11' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
9' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.

5' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar.
4' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner with a short pass.
4' Riccardo Saponara (Verona) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
2' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
Cagliari will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Daniele Orsato.
